jobs.title: Climate Data Scientist
jobs.description: Join our team to analyze global climate data and develop predictive models for climate change impacts. You'll work with satellite data, weather station records, and advanced statistical methods to understand climate patterns and trends.
requirements: PhD in Climate Science, Atmospheric Physics, or related field
5+ years experience with climate data analysis
Proficiency in Python, R, and MATLAB
Experience with NetCDF, HDF5, and geospatial data formats
Knowledge of climate models (GCMs, RCMs) and statistical downscaling

jobs.title: Renewable Energy Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Design and optimize renewable energy systems including solar, wind, and battery storage. You'll work on grid integration, energy forecasting, and system performance optimization for utility-scale projects.
requirements: MS in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy, or related field
3+ years experience in renewable energy systems
Knowledge of power systems, grid codes, and energy storage
Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, PVsyst, or WindPRO
Understanding of electrical grid operations and smart grid technologies

jobs.title: Meteorologist / Weather Analyst
jobs.description: Work within a top global hedge fund as a Weather Analyst/Meteorologist, applying atmospheric science and data analytics to trading strategies. The role focuses on research into atmospheric predictability, weather models, and fundamental market analysis, directly supporting investment decisions across energy and related products.
requirements: 2+ years of experience as a Weather Analyst/Meteorologist in a buyside or trade shop environment
Strong knowledge of power and energy markets
Proficiency in Python
STEM degree (Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, Data Science, or related field)

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Weather and Climate Risks
jobs.description: Join FM’s world-class research team to tackle the pressing challenges of weather and climate risks. You will lead research on extreme weather catastrophes such as tropical cyclones, severe convective storms, and extreme precipitation, contributing to global Climate Risk & Resilience activities and the development of hazard models for wind, flood, storms, and wildfire risks.
requirements: MS in meteorology, data science, or adjacent field with 3+ years professional experience, OR PhD in meteorology, data science, or adjacent field
Strong knowledge of statistical/dynamical downscaling techniques
Experience with global and/or regional climate models and CMIP6 output
Ability to analyze large atmospheric datasets (GeoTIFF, NetCDF, HDF, GRIB)
Proficiency in at least two programming languages (Python, R, Fortran, Matlab)
Strong communication and teamwork skills
skills: GIS (ArcGIS, QGIS, GDAL, Google Earth Engine)
